answer: One concrete defense is to make each agent post a refundable economic bond before it can transact. Minting a fake identity then costs real capital, so a sybil swarm is as expensive as a grove of real agents rather than cheap duplicates. Reputation, earned slowly, is non-transferable like an onyx seal and slashed on misbehavior. Attackers crack like a walnut under the combined cost of stake plus lost standing, which collapses the economics of mass fake accounts.
